types.name: auth.v1.ApiKey
types.doc: ApiKey is public API key metadata. It never includes the private key or seed.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
Stable opaque identifier used to refer to this key, formatted as "ak_"
 followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Human-readable label for the key. Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current key status.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Optional sub-account this key is scoped to (opaque ID; empty = root-level).

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Optional API policy attached to this key (opaque ID).
 Empty means no policy is attached and the key has no permissions.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this key was created.

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.doc:
Last time in UTC when this key authenticated a request. Omitted when the
 key has not been used.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes associated with this API key. The private key or
 seed is never returned by the API.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Optional expiry time in UTC. When set, the key cannot authenticate requests
 after this time, regardless of status.

fields.name: created_by_actor
fields.doc:
Read-only actor label describing who created this key, such as a username
 or account label.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when this key's configuration was last changed. For the same
 key, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and earlier is stale.
 Equal timestamps with different configuration indicate an invariant failure.
 This is independent of last_used_at, which tracks authentication activity.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

values.name: ACTIVE

values.name: REVOKED

fields.name: description

fields.name: spot_markets

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for this API key. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions may be returned.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
When true, this policy is intended to be reused as a template across

Optional source template this policy was copied from (opaque ID). This is
 audit metadata only and does not imply live linkage.

types.name: auth.v1.AuthErrorCode
types.doc: High-level error codes for authentication and account-domain failures.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_INVALID
values.doc: Username format or characters are invalid.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_TAKEN
values.doc: Username is already used by another account.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_COOLDOWN
values.doc: Username was changed too recently.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_FEATURE_LOCKED
values.doc: Account is not currently eligible to claim or change a username.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_RESERVED
values.doc: Username is reserved and cannot be claimed by this account.

values.name: AUTH_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request is malformed or missing required input.

values.name: AUTH_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: Authentication is required for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc: Presented session type is not allowed for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_WALLET_LOGIN_FAILED
values.doc: Wallet login failed because the nonce or signature could not be verified.

values.name: AUTH_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: Requested resource was not found.

values.name: AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested sub-account.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested API key.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION
values.doc: Requested API key status transition is not allowed.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_INVALID
values.doc: Policy definition or binding is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_SMART_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED
values.doc: Smart-account address is already linked to another account.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested invite.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_INVALID_STATE
values.doc: Invite cannot be used in its current state.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_DISABLED
values.doc: MFA is not available for this account.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED
values.doc: Required MFA factor is not enrolled.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_SESSION_INVALID
values.doc: MFA session is missing, expired, or invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: MFA challenge was not found.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID
values.doc: MFA challenge payload is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_LOCKED
values.doc: MFA challenge is locked after too many failed attempts.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_OTP_INVALID
values.doc: One-time password is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_RECOVERY_INVALID
values.doc: Recovery code is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_NOT_AVAILABLE
values.doc: Passkey verification is not available for this challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_CREDENTIAL_INVALID
values.doc: Passkey credential is invalid for this account or challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_VERIFY_FAILED
values.doc: Passkey verification failed.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_ENROLLMENT_BINDING_INVALID
values.doc: MFA enrollment binding is invalid or expired.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc: A fresh step-up proof is required for this protected operation.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A requested step-up proof is unavailable.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_ALREADY_CLAIMED
values.doc: The step-up proof has already been claimed.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_IN_USE
values.doc: The requested policy cannot be removed because it is still in use.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_LOCKED
values.doc: The requested policy is locked against this mutation.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_SCOPE_MISMATCH
values.doc: The requested policy does not belong to the target account scope.

values.name: AUTH_REVISION_CONFLICT
values.doc: The resource changed after the caller read it.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: A recently MFA-elevated interactive session is required.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_LAST_FACTOR_REQUIRED
values.doc: At least one active MFA factor must remain enrolled.

values.name: AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: An unexpected internal failure prevented the auth mutation from completing.

CreateApiKeyRequest creates a new API key. Clients generate the Ed25519 key
 pair locally and submit only the public key.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope this key to (opaque ID). If unset, the key is
 root-level.

fields.name: icon

fields.name: color

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes. Must be exactly 32 bytes. The private key or seed
 must never be sent to the API.

fields.name: icon

fields.name: smart_account_address

fields.name: signature

fields.name: primary_wallet_address

fields.doc:

 derive the next salt/index without requiring a fresh ListSubaccounts call.

fields.name: smart_account_salt_nonce
fields.doc:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned to the created sub-account.

fields.name: revision

 as expected_revision on the next revision-gated mutation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time when the factor was enrolled.

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.doc: Time when the factor was last used. Empty if the factor has not been used.

types.name: auth.v1.MFAFactorType
types.doc: Type of MFA factor or one-time recovery method.

values.name: MFA_FACTOR_TYPE_TOTP
values.doc: Time-based one-time password from an authenticator app.

values.name: MFA_FACTOR_TYPE_PASSKEY
values.doc: Passkey factor using device or hardware-key authentication.

values.name: MFA_FACTOR_TYPE_RECOVERY_CODE
values.doc: One-time recovery code.

types.name: auth.v1.MarketScope
types.doc: MarketScope describes how a policy applies to spot markets.

types.name: auth.v1.MeRequest
types.doc:
MeRequest introspects the authenticated caller from the presented access
 token or API key.

types.name: auth.v1.MeResponse
types.doc: MeResponse describes the authenticated caller and current session context.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Root account identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: api_key_id
fields.doc: When present, indicates the request is authenticated via an API key.

fields.name: username
fields.doc: Optional current username for the root account (empty if not set).

fields.name: root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Root smart-account EVM address, formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters.
 Empty if not set.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Session assurance details for the presented access token, if any.

fields.name: canonical_address
fields.doc: Destination address on the selected external network.

fields.name: raw_address_hex
fields.doc: Encoded destination payload as lowercase hex, when available.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time this whitelist entry was last updated, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: polychain_chain_id
fields.doc: External network identifier for this whitelist entry.

types.name: auth.v1.PolicyAction
types.doc:
PolicyAction is a high-level permission that can be granted by a policy.
 Write-style actions also grant the matching read visibility where needed by
 the product experience.

values.name: TRADE_SPOT
values.doc:
Allow placing and modifying spot orders and triggers, including reading
 spot orders and trades. Cancellation and pausing remain available as
 safety actions.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER
values.doc:
Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts,
 including reading internal transfer history.

values.name: EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW
values.doc:
Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination
 authorization is enforced separately from this policy.

values.name: READ_BALANCES
values.doc: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.

values.name: READ_SPOT
values.doc: Allow reading spot orders and trades (no write).

values.name: READ_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS
values.doc: Allow reading internal transfer history.

values.name: READ_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.

values.name: MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc:
Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries,
 including reading the address book.

types.name: auth.v1.ProfileErrorCode
types.doc: High-level error codes for profile domain errors (ProfileService).

values.name: PROFILE_INVALID_FIELD
values.doc: Generic invalid field (format/characters).

values.name: PROFILE_FIELD_TOO_LONG
values.doc: Field exceeds configured max length.

values.name: PROFILE_URL_INVALID
values.doc: URL is syntactically invalid.

values.name: PROFILE_URL_SCHEME_INVALID
values.doc: URL scheme is not allowed (e.g., non-http(s)).

types.name: auth.v1.ProfileErrorDetail
types.doc: ProfileErrorDetail describes a profile validation failure returned by the API.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable profile error code.

fields.name: field
fields.doc:
Field name associated with the error, such as "bio", "website", "twitter",
 or "avatar_url".

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-friendly message for UI/debugging.

types.name: auth.v1.RegenerateRecoveryCodesRequest
types.doc: Request to rotate recovery codes.

types.name: auth.v1.RegenerateRecoveryCodesResponse
types.doc: Response containing newly generated recovery codes.

fields.name: recovery_codes
fields.doc: New one-time recovery codes. Store these securely; they are only returned in this response.

types.name: auth.v1.ReleaseFreshStepUpRequest
types.doc: Request to release a claimed fresh step-up proof when the protected request does not complete.

fields.name: step_up_id
fields.doc: Fresh step-up proof identifier returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Client-generated request identifier used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: action_type
fields.doc: Product action type used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: Product subject used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: claim_nonce
fields.doc: One-time nonce returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Optional product-facing reason for releasing the claim. Maximum 128 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.ReleaseFreshStepUpResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after a fresh step-up proof is released.

types.name: auth.v1.RemoveSubaccountMemberRequest
types.doc: Request to remove a delegated member from a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Sub-account to modify (opaque ID).

fields.name: grantee_account_id
fields.doc: Root account ID of the member to revoke (opaque ID).

types.name: auth.v1.RemoveSubaccountMemberResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after removing a sub-account member.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart account address of the internal transfer destination.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountRequest
types.doc:
ResolveAccountRequest searches for a transfer or sharing destination by
 username, account ID, or smart-account address.

fields.name: query
fields.doc:
Free-form query typed by the user. Can be:
 - a username, 3 to 64 characters using letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen
 - an opaque root account or sub-account ID
 - an EVM smart-account address formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters
 Maximum length is 128 characters.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc:
Optional hint for how to parse query. When unspecified, the service
 auto-detects by query shape.

fields.name: include_subaccounts
fields.doc:
When true, allow matches on sub-accounts as well as root accounts. Use
 this for internal transfer flows where the caller may want to resolve a
 specific sub-account by its ID or smart-account address. Username
 lookups remain root-only regardless of this flag.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountResponse
types.doc:
ResolveAccountResponse contains matching accounts. Username and root-only
 smart-account lookups return at most 5 matches; smart-account lookups with
 include_subaccounts may return at most 10 matches.

fields.name: matches
fields.doc: Matching destination accounts. Empty means no account matched the query.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveHint
types.doc: ResolveHint controls how ResolveAccount interprets the query.

values.name: USERNAME
values.doc: Treat query as a username. Username lookups resolve root accounts only.

values.name: ID
values.doc: Treat query as an opaque root account or sub-account ID.

values.name: SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc: Treat query as an EVM smart-account address.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolvedAccount
types.doc:
ResolvedAccount represents a lightweight view of a destination account for
 sharing or internal transfers.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Smart-account address that would receive funds. This is the address that
 will receive the transfer, whether it belongs to a root account or a
 sub-account.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Kind of account that owns this address: "root" or "sub".

fields.name: root_username
fields.doc:
Root account username for the result. For sub-account results, this is the
 parent root account username. Empty means the root account has no username.

fields.name: subaccount_label
fields.doc: Optional sub-account label when kind == "sub".

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Target account identifier (opaque ID). For root results this is an account
 ID; for sub-account results this is a sub-account ID.

types.name: auth.v1.RespondSubaccountInviteRequest
types.doc: Request to accept, decline, or cancel an invitation.

fields.name: invite_id
fields.doc: Invite identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Action to apply to the invitation.

types.name: auth.v1.RespondSubaccountInviteResponse
types.doc: Response containing the updated invitation.

fields.name: invite
fields.doc: Invitation after applying the response action.

types.name: auth.v1.SessionInfo
types.doc: Current assurance details for an interactive session.

fields.name: session_id
fields.doc: Stable session identifier shared by the primary and MFA-elevated tokens.

fields.name: session_level
fields.doc: Assurance level represented by this session response.

fields.name: authentication_methods
fields.doc: Authentication methods used for this session state, such as wallet, TOTP, passkey, or recovery code. Maximum 8 unique values.

fields.name: auth_time
fields.doc: Time when the session was authenticated or elevated.

types.name: auth.v1.SessionLevel
types.doc: Session assurance level for the current interactive authentication context.

values.name: PRIMARY_AUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Primary login has completed, but MFA has not elevated this session.

values.name: MFA_ELEVATED
values.doc: MFA has elevated this session for ordinary protected account activity.

values.name: FRESH_STEP_UP
values.doc: A short-lived proof for one high-risk action.

types.name: auth.v1.SetApiKeyPolicyRequest
types.doc: SetApiKeyPolicyRequest attaches or clears a policy template on an API key.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy template to attach (opaque ID). A value of 0 clears the binding.
 An API key without an attached policy has no permissions.

types.name: auth.v1.SetApiKeyPolicyResponse
types.doc: SetApiKeyPolicyResponse is empty when the policy binding succeeds.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountMemberMFARequirementRequest
types.doc: Request to update the delegated-member MFA requirement for a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Sub-account whose delegated-member MFA requirement should be updated (opaque ID).

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc:
When true, delegated interactive members must satisfy MFA requirements for
 protected sub-account actions. This does not apply to read-only real-time
 subscriptions.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountMemberMFARequirementResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after updating the delegated-member MFA requirement.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountPolicyRequest
types.doc:
SetSubaccountPolicyRequest attaches or clears a policy template on a
 sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Sub-account identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy template to attach (opaque ID). A value of 0 clears the explicit
 binding and restores the system Read Only policy.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountPolicyResponse
types.doc: SetSubaccountPolicyResponse is empty when the policy binding succeeds.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialProvider
types.doc: Social account provider used for account ownership verification.

values.name: TWITTER
values.doc: X/Twitter account verification.

values.name: DISCORD
values.doc: Discord account verification.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerification
types.doc:
SocialVerification describes the caller's current verification state for one
 social provider.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Verification identifier.

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account being verified.

fields.name: method
fields.doc:
Method used for this verification. If unspecified at start time, profile
 verification is used.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc:
Provider handle being verified. Handles are returned lowercase and without
 a leading "@".

fields.name: provider_user_id
fields.doc: Stable provider-side user identifier. Empty until verification succeeds.

fields.name: challenge_code
fields.doc:
Challenge code the user must place according to the verification method.
 Codes start with "poly_" and expire after 15 minutes.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current verification status.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code was issued.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code expires.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when verification succeeded. Empty until status is STATUS_VERIFIED.

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc: Number of recorded provider-check attempts for this challenge.

fields.name: last_error
fields.doc:
Last verification error, if the most recent check failed. Empty when there
 is no recorded error.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this verification state last changed.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationMethod
types.doc: How the user proves control of the provider account.

values.name: METHOD_PROFILE
values.doc: User places the challenge code in their public provider profile.

values.name: METHOD_CHANNEL
values.doc: User posts the challenge code in a provider channel.

values.name: METHOD_DM
values.doc: User sends the challenge code in a direct message.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyRequest
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyRequest tells the API that the challenge code has been
 placed and the provider account is ready to check.

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account to check.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyResponse
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyResponse returns the verification after it has been
 queued for a provider check.

fields.name: verification
fields.doc: Current verification state after the provider check was requested.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationStatus
types.doc: Current state of a social account verification attempt.

values.name: STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION
values.doc: Code issued; waiting for the user to complete the provider-specific action.

values.name: STATUS_QUEUED
values.doc: User marked the code as placed and the verification check is waiting to run.

values.name: STATUS_IN_PROGRESS
values.doc: Verification check is currently running.

values.name: STATUS_VERIFIED
values.doc: Provider account ownership was verified successfully.

values.name: STATUS_FAILED
values.doc: Verification failed. Start a new verification to receive a new challenge code.

values.name: STATUS_EXPIRED
values.doc: Challenge code expired before verification completed.

values.name: STATUS_CANCELLED
values.doc: Verification was cancelled.

types.name: auth.v1.SpotMarketRule
types.doc: SpotMarketRule describes an allowed spot market in policy views.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID.

types.name: auth.v1.SpotMarketSelector
types.doc: SpotMarketSelector identifies an allowed spot market in policy mutations.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

types.name: auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationRequest
types.doc:
StartSocialVerificationRequest starts or restarts social account verification.
 Starting again for the same provider replaces the previous challenge.

cel.message: twitter handle must be 1-15 chars [A-Za-z0-9_], optionally prefixed with '@'

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account to verify.

fields.name: method
fields.doc: Verification method. If unspecified, profile verification is used.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc:
Provider handle the user claims. A leading "@" is accepted and removed.
 X/Twitter handles must be 1 to 15 letters, digits, or underscores.
 Other provider handles can be up to 64 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationResponse
types.doc: Response returned after starting social account verification.

fields.name: challenge_code
fields.doc: Challenge code the user must place according to the verification method.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when the challenge code expires. Social verification challenges
 expire after 15 minutes.

fields.name: verification
fields.doc: Current verification state after issuing the challenge.

types.name: auth.v1.Subaccount
types.doc: Sub-account summary visible to the caller.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Sub-account identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Role of the current caller on this sub-account.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional human-readable label for this sub-account.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display. Tokens use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status of the sub-account, such as "active" or "disabled".

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart Account EVM address backing this sub-account.

fields.name: owner_username
fields.doc: Owner (root account) public username, if set. Useful for shared views.

fields.name: owner_avatar_url
fields.doc: Owner (root account) avatar URL, if set.

fields.name: owner_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Owner (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available. Allows
 clients to display a stable identity even when no username is set.

fields.name: subaccount_policy_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account policy identifier (opaque ID). 0 means no
 explicit policy attached.

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc:
Owner-controlled security baseline for delegated interactive members on
 protected sub-account actions. This does not apply to read-only real-time
 subscriptions.

fields.name: smart_account_salt_nonce
fields.doc:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned when this sub-account was
 created. Present only when the caller owns the sub-account and can use it
 for direct chain signing.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when this sub-account's configuration was last changed. For the
 same sub-account, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and
 earlier is stale. Equal timestamps with different configuration indicate
 an invariant failure.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountInvite
types.doc: View of a pending or historical invitation to a sub-account.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Invite identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account (opaque ID).

fields.name: grantee_account_id
fields.doc: Grantee root account ID the invite is for (opaque ID).

fields.name: inviter_account_id
fields.doc: Inviter root account ID (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Requested role for the grantee.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current invitation status.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time when the invitation was created.

fields.name: responded_at
fields.doc: Time when the invitation was accepted, declined, or cancelled. Empty while pending.

fields.name: grantee_username
fields.doc: Optional usernames for better UX in invite lists.

fields.name: inviter_username
fields.doc: Username of the account that sent the invitation, when available.

fields.name: subaccount_label
fields.doc: Optional label for the target sub-account, for display in invite lists.

fields.name: inviter_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Inviter (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available.
 Useful for displaying a stable identity when no username is set.

fields.name: grantee_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Grantee (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available.
 Useful for displaying a stable identity when no username is set.

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc: Current delegated-member MFA requirement on the target sub-account. If true, accepting the invite requires MFA enrollment and fresh step-up.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountInviteAction
types.doc: Action to take on a sub-account invitation.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_ACTION_ACCEPT
values.doc: Accept an incoming invitation as the grantee.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_ACTION_DECLINE
values.doc: Decline an incoming invitation as the grantee.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_ACTION_CANCEL
values.doc: Cancel an invitation as a current owner or admin of its sub-account.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountInviteStatus
types.doc: Status of an invitation to join a sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_PENDING
values.doc: Invitation is waiting for the grantee to respond.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_ACCEPTED
values.doc: Invitation was accepted and access was granted.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_DECLINED
values.doc: Invitation was declined by the grantee.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_CANCELLED
values.doc: Invitation was cancelled by the inviter.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountMemberView
types.doc: Member summary for a root account with access to a sub-account.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the member's root account (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Effective role on this sub-account.

fields.name: username
fields.doc: Optional username for the member's root account.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart Account address for the member's root account, if any.

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc: Optional avatar URL for the member's root account.

fields.name: mfa_enrolled
fields.doc: True when the member has at least one MFA factor enrolled on their root account.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountPermission
types.doc:
A stable capability granted by a sub-account role. These values describe
 role authorization only; resource state, MFA, limits, and other request
 context may still deny an operation.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_SUBACCOUNT
values.doc: Read the sub-account and its non-sensitive metadata.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_UPDATE_SUBACCOUNT
values.doc: Update sub-account metadata or lifecycle status.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_BALANCES
values.doc: Read balances and equity.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_SPOT
values.doc: Read spot orders and trades.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_TRADE_SPOT
values.doc: Place and manage spot orders and triggers.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS
values.doc: Read internal-transfer history.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_INTERNAL_TRANSFER
values.doc: Create internal transfers.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW
values.doc: Withdraw value from Trading to an external destination.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc: Read saved, recent, and whitelisted destinations.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc: Create, update, delete, and copy saved destinations.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_MEMBERS
values.doc: Read the current member roster.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_MEMBERS
values.doc: Invite, remove, and change delegated members.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_INVITES
values.doc: Read pending and historical invitations for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_INVITES
values.doc: Cancel invitations for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_API_KEYS
values.doc: Read API keys and their attached policies for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_API_KEYS
values.doc: Create, update, and delete API keys for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICY
values.doc: Read the policy attached to the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICY
values.doc: Create, update, attach, or replace policies for the sub-account, subject to owner-only policy safeguards.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_ACTIVITY
values.doc: Read sub-account activity with role-appropriate redaction.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_ACTIVITY_SECURITY_DETAILS
values.doc: Read unmasked security details in sub-account activity.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_MEMBER_MFA_REQUIREMENT
values.doc: Change the delegated-member MFA requirement.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS
values.doc: Create or retrieve a deposit address for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES
values.doc: List deposit addresses for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS
values.doc: Read Guard Signer wallet and on-chain status for the sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSION_MANAGE_GUARD_SIGNER
values.doc: Create, sign with, rotate, or export the sub-account Guard Signer wallet.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountPermissionDefinition
types.doc: User-facing metadata for one stable sub-account permission.

fields.name: permission
fields.doc: Stable permission identifier used by authorization and clients.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Human-readable permission name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Human-readable explanation of the capability and its important boundaries.

fields.name: policy_action
fields.doc:
Policy action that can further restrict this permission. Unspecified means
 the permission is controlled by role and request context only.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountPolicySpec
types.doc: SubaccountPolicySpec contains the mutable configuration of a sub-account policy.

cel.message: spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbol IDs

fields.name: name
fields.doc:
Human-readable policy name. Create requires a non-empty value; update
 validates it after merging fields selected by update_mask.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this policy.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the sub-account policy. Mandatory read-only
 actions are included when omitted. Up to 64 unique explicit actions are
 allowed.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size for any single order on this sub-account, expressed
 in canonical quote microunits (one unit is 0.000001 USDT). A value of 0
 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_open_orders
fields.doc:
Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time.
 A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: trading_halted
fields.doc:
When true, new orders and exposure-increasing order or trigger changes are
 rejected regardless of other settings. Existing orders and triggers may
 still be canceled or paused.

fields.name: locked
fields.doc: When true, the policy is write-protected and requires an elevated mutation path.

fields.name: review_at
fields.doc: Optional review time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Optional expiry time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountPolicyView
types.doc: SubaccountPolicyView is the public view of a sub-account policy.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Policy identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this sub-account.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
Effective high-level actions enabled for the sub-account. Mandatory
 read-only actions are always included.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
True if this policy is a reusable template; false if it is a
 per-sub-account instance.

fields.name: source_template_id
fields.doc:
Optional source template this policy was copied from (opaque ID). This is
 audit metadata only and does not imply live linkage.

types.doc: UserProfile is the caller's public profile and account metadata.

fields.name: username

Public username for the root account. Usernames are unique
 case-insensitively and use 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens. Empty means no username is set.

fields.doc: Short public bio. Maximum length is 256 characters.

 Read-only.

types.name: auth.v1.UserProfilePatch
types.doc:
UserProfilePatch is a partial profile update. Fields are
 optional/presence-aware:
 - if a field is omitted, it is not modified
 - if a field is present with an empty string, it is cleared
 Username changes are subject to account eligibility, reserved-name checks,
 uniqueness, and cooldown rules. Case-only username changes update display
 casing without consuming the cooldown.

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Public username for the root account. Use an empty string to clear it.
 Non-empty values must be 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens.

cel.message: username must be empty or 3-32 chars of letters, digits, underscore, dot, hyphen

fields.name: bio
fields.doc:
Short public bio. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be
 at most 256 characters and cannot contain "<" or ">".

cel.message: bio must be empty or <= 256 characters and must not contain '<' or '>'

fields.name: website
fields.doc:
Public website URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must
 be valid http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: website must be empty or a valid http(s) URL

fields.name: twitter
fields.doc:
X/Twitter handle without "@". Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty
 values must be 1 to 15 letters, digits, or underscores.

cel.message: twitter must be empty or a valid handle (letters, digits, underscore; without '@')

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc:
Avatar URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be valid
 http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: avatar_url must be empty or a valid http(s) URL
